# Measure Findings: Dashboard Recent Sessions Layout
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Result

The dashboard session-list implementation passes all available automated checks. Source and feature evidence confirm the derived thumbnail, metadata payload, fallback behavior, full-row protected route, and removal of the `Open session` badge. Authenticated visual acceptance remains open.

## Acceptance Findings

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |

| Remove the numbered placeholder and `Open session` badge | Pass in source | `dashboard.tsx` contains the thumbnail-and-metadata row without the old badge or numbering |
| Apply the shared presentation to both roles | Pass in shared component | `dashboard.tsx` is the shared dashboard page; `DashboardTest` covers participant and administrator dashboard state |
| Preserve responsive behavior | Not yet verified | Authenticated browser review is still required at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths |
| Confirm external thumbnail availability | Not yet verified | `i.ytimg.com` availability and rendered visual quality require authenticated browser review |

## Quality And Security

- Full PHP tests, PHPStan, Pint, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, production build, and diff checks pass.
- No new route, authorization rule, data model, upload flow, or private-file behavior was introduced.
- The existing YouTube residual URL-sharing risk remains unchanged. The thumbnail URL is public host metadata and is not treated as video protection.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, cookies, or real participant data were added.

## Acceptance Boundary

Local implementation and automated verification pass. Do not treat this as launch acceptance. Complete authenticated desktop, tablet, mobile, light-mode, and dark-mode review for both roles, including row navigation, thumbnail rendering, fallback behavior, and no horizontal overflow.
